code_path: Full5x5 B_m,B_a,B_eff matrices, numerical slogdet and solve; no use of old inverse-polynomial evaluator.
strict_scope: The analytic correction and inherited full-support tail bound are proved. Midpoint interior quadrature has no error certificate. No sampled value is promoted to a global bound.

checkpoint.save: ActualPID, hashes, completed orbit count, accumulated results; resumable before any subsequent checkpoint.

stopping: One fixed partition only; report necessity pilot. If competitive, a separately registered rigorous interval integration may follow. No top4, no spatial grid, no mutation of locked order directories.
